scope: Original-source report-year and entity attribution only; Finland/Ukraine manifest entries for 2019–2024.

decision_semantics.decision: Source reporting-period decision only: verified, mismatch or uncertain. Entity findings are separate in entity_attribution.decision.
decision_semantics.claimed_period: Period explicitly identified by the original report title or management statement, not inferred from the manifest, publication date, or accounting comparatives.
decision_semantics.entity_decision: verified means the bounded source identifies the bank or its reporting brand; it is not certification of legal continuity, country-only coverage, or the scoring unit.
decision_semantics.quarantine: Any confirmed wrong-year source quarantines its whole checkpoint bank-year unless both an independent correct-year report and separable existing cached extraction prove validity. No such exception is established here.

methodology.source: Only actual local manifest PDFs were used as report evidence. No parsed PDF caches, workbook extractions or checkpoints were used to validate periods.
methodology.extraction: PyMuPDF/fitz Page.get_text("text", sort=False), read-only, in memory; all PDF page-1 text extracted in bulk, then targeted pages within the first eight.
methodology.page_numbering: Physical PDF pages, one-based; not printed report page labels.
methodology.quotes: Original source language retained; whitespace normalized. Three fitz-rendered covers use explicitly marked visual transcription because the extracted text omitted their period or was empty.
methodology.rendering: fitz page.get_pixmap rendered entry 3, 106 and 164 covers in memory; no OCR services or raster files were written.
methodology.duplicate_test: SHA-256 of complete original PDF bytes for all 181 entries; exact duplicate groups compared by checkpoint year and bank identity.
methodology.supplementary_check: For the Oschadbank 2019/2020 and Universal Bank 2022/2023 source pairs, first-eight-page extracted texts are identical but full PDF hashes differ; no claim of byte-identical PDFs or full-document text equality is made.
methodology.selection: bank_reports_all.csv duplicates the exact multiset union of the 12 country-year manifests; both manifest locations are recorded per entry and the 181 entries are counted once.
